characterization_methods: 11B and 31P Magic Angle Spinning (MAS) Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) Spectroscopy
evidence: The procedure used for IR, lIB and 31p MAS NMR, mass-spectrometric investigations and for quantitative analyses of B and P in the surface layer of modified silica were described elsewhere. ... The investigations of the structure of the boron phosphate species was carried out by lIB and31p MAS NMR spectroscopy.* ... The formation of the methyl chloride was confirmed by mass-spectrometry of the gas phase in contact with the sample. ... So, in liB NMR spectra of the samples prepared by sequential chemisorption of trimethoxyborate and phosphoryl-trichloride, ... The NMR spectra of the samples prepared by i-, 2- and 5-fold sequential vapor chemisorption of trimethoxyborate and phosphoryl trichloride are not practically distinguished either in the chemical shift or in the band width. ... In the 31p NMR spectra of the silica treated with trimethoxyborate and phosphoryl-trichloride vapors a relatively sharp band at -11.8 ppm was observed. ... For the sample treated twice this band becomes broader and shifts to -14.0 ppm. ... The broadening of the bands may be associated both with the presence of residual P-C1 bonds and with the amorphous structure of boron phosphate compounds. ... In the lIB NMR spectra of the same sample two bands are observed. ... The sharp one may be assigned to BO 4 species in BPO 4 and the broader one - to trigonal fragments of BO 3 in boric anhydride. ... The latter can be removed by washing with water. In the lIB and 31p NMR spectra of the samples, after washing the bands observed are identical with those of BPO 4.
